content.text: In Zimbabwe, digital creators face a harsh reality: platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often restricted or unavailable. This [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] gap leaves creators without a reliable way to sell their digital products and receive [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-stack-started-generating|The Payment]]s. However, there's a solution that puts creators back in control: sovereign commerce infrastructure. By deploying a digital store on [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-every-detail|cloudflare]] Pages, you can break free from platform dependencies and own your commerce stack.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Sovereign commerce infrastructure works by giving you complete ownership and control over your digital store. With Cloudflare Pages, you can host your store for free, while also leveraging Cloudflare Workers for backend logic and Supabase for order storage. This stack is designed to be highly available, secure, and scalable, ensuring that your store remains online and functional even in the face of platform outages or restrictions. By deploying this infrastructure, you can ensure that your digital business remains resilient and independent.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to gather a few essential components. First, you'll need a Cloudflare account and a GitHub repository to host your store's code. You'll also need to set up a Supabase instance for storing orders and customer data. Additionally, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account to enable automatic crypto payment processing. With these components in place, you'll be ready to start deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your digital store. With NOWPayments, you can enable automatic crypto payment processing, allowing customers to pay with over 300 different cryptocurrencies. You'll also need to configure your store's delivery pipeline, using Cloudflare Workers to automate the delivery of digital products to customers. By integrating these components, you can create a seamless and efficient payment and delivery experience for your customers.
Deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've deployed your digital store and set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves configuring your store's frontend to interact with your backend logic, as well as testing your payment processing and delivery workflows. With Cloudflare Pages and Workers, you can ensure that your store is highly available and performs well under load, giving you the confidence to start selling your digital products to customers around the world.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows and scales, you'll need to ensure that your infrastructure can keep up with demand. With Cloudflare Pages and Workers, you can scale your store horizontally, adding more instances as needed to handle increased traffic. You'll also need to monitor your store's performance, using analytics tools to identify bottlenecks and optimize your infrastructure for better performance. By scaling your infrastructure effectively, you can ensure that your digital store remains fast, reliable, and secure, even as your customer base grows.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To get started with deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, simply sign up for a Cloudflare account and create a new GitHub repository for your store's code. From there, you can follow our step-by-step guide to deploying your sovereign commerce infrastructure, including setting up your payment and delivery pipeline and configuring your store's frontend and backend logic.
Break free from platform dependencies with sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages, follow these steps: create a Cloudflare account, set up a GitHub repository, configure your Supabase instance, create a NOWPayments account, deploy your store's frontend and backend logic, configure your payment and delivery pipeline, test your store's performance and scalability, and go live with your digital store. With these steps, you can ensure a successful deployment and start selling your digital products to customers around the world.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is sovereign commerce infrastructure?
Sovereign commerce infrastructure refers to a digital commerce stack that is owned and controlled by the creator, rather than a third-party platform.
How does NOWPayments work?
NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment processing, allowing customers to pay with over 300 different cryptocurrencies.
What is Cloudflare Workers?
Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that allows you to run backend logic and automate tasks, such as digital product delivery.
How do I scale my digital store?
You can scale your digital store horizontally, adding more instances as needed to handle increased traffic, and monitor performance using analytics tools.
What is the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack is a pre-configured and tested commerce infrastructure, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, as well as NOWPayments integration and end-to-end testing.
Scale your digital store horizontally with Cloudflare Workers.
